headlineOfDay: US inflation runs hot and the 10-year yield nears 5%, with a Fed hike now in view, as Nvidia's spy-affair scandal rattles tech and Anthropic's IPO nears.

markets.summary: Wall Street fell, with the Nasdaq down 0.74% and the S&P 500 off 0.38%, as a hotter-than-expected US inflation reading pushed the 10-year Treasury yield back towards 5%. Nvidia fell 5.47% amid its CEO scandal, while European and UK shares rose, helped by miners and a firmer copper price.

indices.label: FTSE 100
indices.note: Gains were led by mining stocks as commodity prices recovered.

rates_fx.label: US 10Y yield
rates_fx.note: Yield rose towards 5% after hotter-than-expected US inflation data and Waller's comments on a possible December hike.

losers.name: Nvidia
losers.note: Fell as the CEO scandal over an alleged Chinese spy deepened and the board launched an investigation.

stories.headline: Hot US inflation and Waller comments lift rate-hike bets
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, and Fed Governor Waller said he is leaning towards a December rate rise, possibly of half a point. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to nearly 5%, weighing on equities.
